article_five_senses.summary: You use your senses every minute of the day. After reading this, you can name the five senses, explain what each one does for you, and test your senses so you know how well they work.
article_five_senses.title: Discovering the Five Senses

article_talking_about_family.summary: Your family is the people who belong with you. After reading this you can name the people in your family, say what each of them does, and introduce your family to somebody new.
article_talking_about_family.title: Talking About Your Family
